label: About
title: About Phosphor Provenance Habitat
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 526 recent saved-signal files and 195 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @DamiDefi: Claude Code cannot read 300 files at once. So someone built a system that lets it... and @Eng_china5: A Chinese student built an interesting app using vibe coding that visualizes nearly..., plus 4 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Phosphor Provenance Habitat: Cinematic still of a phosphor provenance habitat, browserless media shrine: a dark botanical chamber where a hero citation canopy and a raised museum-island archipelago dominate, shot through smoked CRT glass with warm stage-light rupture from above. Wet moss, enamel map tiles, cassette acrylic, and beige seams carr... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left CRT vertical phosphor edge, central suspended light-node canopy, and raised wet tile island edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
